    FAQ

    Homogenisation is a process which mixes the milk completely for equal distribution of fat in every drop. Pasteurisation is the process of making the milk safe from any germs, through HTST - 72 degree for 15 secs which keeps the nutrition intact in comparison to UHT.
    Absolutely, it is ready to drink straight from the bottle, without any boiling.
    Our milk is homogenized milk which does not produce cream in the traditional sense. Homogenization is a process where milk is mechanically treated to break down fat molecules into smaller, uniform sizes, preventing the cream from separating and floating to the top. This gives the milk a smooth, consistent texture. In homogenized milk, the fat is evenly distributed, so you won’t see the cream separate out.
    The shelf life of Pride of Cows milk is 7 days when stored under refrigeration below 4℃. However, we would still suggest you to consume the milk within 4 - 5 days to get the intact nutrition value of Pride of Cows milk. Once opened you need to consume it within 48 hours.
    We have breed of Holstein Friesian cows which produce milk that contains both A1 and A2 proteins for a unique and balanced nutritional profile.
    Pride of Cows is here to resolve your query and to help you understand milk better. A1 and A2 are nothing but the beta casein milk protein which is available in milk. A1 and A2 are merely marketing terms used across by dairy brands, which we at Pride of Cows refrain from using to educate our customers the right way. The milk that comes to your doorstep from Pride of Cows is unadulterated farm fresh milk with no antibiotics or preservatives sourced from best breed of cows around the world present at our farms.
    Please visit www.prideofcows.com or you can visit our farm as well at Pune, Manchar.

    How endless subscription work?

    7-Day Payment Authorization

    The subscription amount is blocked for a rolling 7-day period.
    For example, if your milk is delivered on Monday, the payment for the next Monday will be automatically blocked.

    Tentative Future Bookings

    Deliveries beyond the 7-day period will appear as tentative bookings in the system. No payment will be deducted until the corresponding weekly authorization occurs.

    Automatic Weekly Payment Authorization

    Every 7 days, the required amount for the upcoming week will be blocked from your wallet balance. This ensures a hassle-free experience without requiring manual payments.

    Flexibility & Complete Control

    Users can modify, pause, or cancel their subscription at any time before the next payment cycle begins. Enjoy the convenience of adjusting your deliveries based on your needs.

    Seamless Auto-Renewal

    The subscription renews automatically every week, ensuring continuous service without interruptions.

    Transparent Payment Tracking

    Users can view a detailed breakdown of:
    Blocked payments, Tentative bookings,
    Upcoming deductions All transaction details are visible in your account dashboard, ensuring full transparency.
